headline: Executive order sets up and starts putting in place a "Department of Government Efficiency" within the executive branch.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a "Department of Government Efficiency" and sets out how it will be put into action. No summary was provided, so details about its specific powers, staff, budget, and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The title suggests the new office will work with or within federal agencies, but the specific effects are not stated in the material provided.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; no separate start date was provided.
